# Commercial retrofit construction contract

Date: 2026-11-20. Property: 3000 S Robertson Blvd, 4th floor, Los Angeles, CA 90034 (CoStar property id 27120, Culver Connect), a full-floor office suite in a privately owned office building; no public funds. Place of signing: {{signing_location}}.

## Parties

Owner: {{owner_name}}, {{owner_address}}, place of business {{owner_place_of_business}}.

Construction lender, if any: {{construction_lender_name}}, {{construction_lender_address}}.

Contractor: {{contractor_name}}, Contractors State License Board licence number {{contractor_license_number}}, classification {{contractor_license_classification}}.

## 1. Work

- LGT_CTRL: fit occupancy sensors and daylight dimming to the 289 existing LED fixtures on the 4th floor (controls listed for the LADWP lighting incentive if it is sought, with LADWP approval before purchase), with the lighting-control acceptance tests the alteration needs.

Start date: {{start_date}}. Completion date: {{completion_date}}. Access to the occupied suite is arranged through the owner.

## 2. Contract price

{{contract_price_usd}}. For reference only, the audit's installed-cost estimate is $48,552 to $97,104 (expected $64,736); it is not a price.

## 3. Payment and retention

Owner pays each undisputed progress payment within 30 days after the Contractor's payment demand. Retention: {{retention_percent}} percent of each payment, not more than 5 percent of each payment or of the contract price, released within 45 days after completion. The Contractor pays each subcontractor within 7 days after receiving each progress payment and its share of retention within 10 days.

## 4. Indemnity

No party is indemnified for its own sole negligence or wilful misconduct, and any indemnity by the Contractor excludes the Owner's active negligence.

## 5. Liens

Subcontractors and suppliers give preliminary notice within 20 days of first furnishing work. Lien releases are given only in the forms of Civil Code sections 8132 to 8138. If the Owner records a notice of completion, the Owner sends a copy within 10 days to the Contractor and to every claimant that gave preliminary notice.

## 6. Contract information (Labor Code 2810)

Contractor's state employer identification number: {{contractor_employer_id}}. Workers' compensation policy: {{workers_comp_policy_number}}, insurer {{workers_comp_insurer}}. Number of workers and total wages: {{workforce_and_wages}}.

## 7. Savings

Energy savings stated in the audit are estimates with low, expected and high values. They are not guaranteed.

## 8. Notice

Contractors are required by law to be licensed and regulated by the Contractors State License Board which has jurisdiction to investigate complaints against contractors if a complaint regarding a patent act or omission is filed within four years of the date of the alleged violation. A complaint regarding a latent act or omission pertaining to structural defects must be filed within 10 years of the date of the alleged violation. Any questions concerning a contractor may be referred to the Registrar, Contractors State License Board, P.O. Box 26000, Sacramento, CA 95826.

## 9. For the attorney

Whether the home solicitation sections can reach a contract signed away from the Contractor's premises; arbitration-notice format; permits and Title 24 compliance forms and acceptance tests for the lighting-control alteration.
